name: 5 Days
source:
Dive deep into the complex and raw reality of grief. Immerse in a world where loss lingers in every corner, and choices shape not only your path but also your emotional healing.

Every step forward feels like another memory slipping through your fingers and yet, the world moves on — forcing you to find a way to follow, even when it feels impossible to let go. 
"She's gone, will you let go?"

[From [url=https://calnite.itch.io/5-days-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
深入了解悲伤的复杂而原始的现实。沉浸在一个每个角落都弥漫着失落感的世界，选择不仅塑造你的道路，也塑造你的情感治愈。

每向前迈出一步，都感觉像是另一段记忆从你的指缝中溜走，然而，世界仍在继续前进——迫使你找到一种追随的方式，即使你感觉不可能放手。
“她走了，你会放手吗？”

[来自[url=https://calnite.itch.io/5-days-demo]itch.io[/url]]
